newsitem.title: SWAZILAND: Golf-Royal Swazi Open, leading second round scores.
newsitem.headline: Golf-Royal Swazi Open, leading second round scores.

text.p: Leading second round scores in the Royal Swazi Open golf tournament at the par-72 Royal Swazi Golf Club near Mbabane on Thursday (South African unless stated):
